While demonstrating a low to moderate hazard for oral exposure (Tier 3), it is largely data deficient (Tier 4) across many other critical hazard classes, including carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity (CMR), endocrine disruption (EDC), inhalation (IHL), dermal and eye (SKN), and organ and systemic (OGN) hazards.
